zarya.16_2: Shield Ally now grants an untalented Shield to a nearby ally upon impact.
zarya.16_3: While at or above 75 Energy, Zarya's cooldowns regenerate 25% faster.
zarya.1_1:
Quest: For every 5 enemy Heroes hit by Particle Grenade, its recharge rate lowers by 0.4375 seconds, up to 3.5 seconds.

Reward: Once Particle Grenade has hit 40 enemy Heroes, its radius is increased by 15%.
zarya.1_2: For 3 seconds after gaining Shield Ally, every 5.35~~0.04~~ damage done by the bearer contributes 1 Energy to Zarya, up to 40 Energy per Shield.
zarya.1_3: Zarya's Basic Attack deals 50% additional damage to enemies in melee range. While above 40 Energy, Zarya's Basic Attack size is increased by 35%.
zarya.1_4:
Regen Globes now instantly grant 20 Energy.

Quest: Spend 150 seconds at or above 50 Energy.

Reward: Gain an additional 20 maximum Energy.
zarya.20_1: Increases Graviton Surge's duration by 1 second and it Silences Heroes caught in its area.
zarya.20_2: Reduce Expulsion Zone's cooldown by 25 seconds and increase its duration by 1.5 seconds.
zarya.20_3: All Particle Grenade charges are returned at once.
zarya.20_4: Activate to reset the cooldown of Personal Barrier and Shield Ally.
zarya.4_1:
Personal Barrier absorbs an additional 140~~0.04~~ damage. 

Passive: Damage absorbed by Zarya's Shields contributes 20% more Energy.
zarya.4_2:
Quest: Regeneration Globes increase Shield Ally absorb amount by 15, up to 300 permanently. 

Reward: After collecting 20 Regen Globes, permanently reduce the cooldown of Shield Ally by 2 seconds.
zarya.4_3: Shield Ally increases the allied Hero's Movement Speed by 50% for the duration.
zarya.4_4: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier and Shield Ally grant 75 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks for 6 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.
zarya.7_1: Particle Grenade deals 25~~0.04~~ more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.
zarya.7_2: Hitting a Hero with Particle Grenade causes Basic Attacks against them to generate 2 Energy. Lasts 4 seconds.
zarya.7_3: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier explodes, dealing 110~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies.

zeratul.10_1:
Activate to cast an untalented version of Zeratul's most recently used Basic Ability, dealing 50% less damage.

Passive: After using an Ability, Zeratul's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 30% more damage.
zeratul.10_2: Slows time in an area to a near standstill, placing allies and enemies in Time Stop for 5 seconds. Zeratul is not affected.
zeratul.13_1: Zeratul gains a Shield equal to 20% of his Maximum Health over 3 seconds while under Permanent Cloak.
zeratul.13_2: Basic Attacks heal for 35% of the damage dealt.
zeratul.13_3:
Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.
zeratul.16_1: Every third consecutive Basic Attack against the same target deals 125% more damage.
zeratul.16_2: If Cleave hits more than one enemy Hero, it deals 40% increased damage and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.
zeratul.16_3: Deal 25% increased damage to enemies while they are marked or Slowed by Singularity Spike.
zeratul.1_1: Increases the radius of Cleave by 33%.
zeratul.1_2:
Quest: Gather Regeneration Globes to lower the Mana cost of Blink by 3, up to 45.

Reward: Upon gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Blink by 1.5 seconds.
zeratul.1_3: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 1 second. Gain 30% Movement Speed while Stealthed.
zeratul.20_1: Might of the Nerazim resets the cooldown of all Basic Abilities.
zeratul.20_2: Singularity Spike no longer costs Mana. Basic Attacks against enemies reduce its cooldown by 1.25 seconds, double versus Heroes.
zeratul.20_3: Reduce the cooldown of Vorpal Blade by 10 seconds. Casting Vorpal Blade grants Zeratul a Shield that absorbs up to 260~~0.04~~ damage for 3 seconds.
zeratul.20_4: Heal for 60% of Spell Damage dealt to Heroes.
zeratul.4_1: Cleave deals an additional 40% damage over 3 seconds.
zeratul.4_2: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes increases all damage dealt by 6% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 30%.
zeratul.4_3:
Activate to gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

Passive: Gain 20% Attack Speed.
zeratul.7_1: After 1.25 seconds, reactivate Blink to return to the point where it was cast from within 4 seconds.
zeratul.7_2: Singularity Spike takes 50% longer to explode. It can be reactivated to teleport to the target, granting 30% increased Move Speed for 3 seconds.
zeratul.7_3: Vorpal Blade gains a 2nd charge. Teleporting to an enemy with Vorpal Blade or entering Permanent Cloak causes Zeratul's next Basic Attack to deal 50% more damage.

zuljin.10_1: For the next 4 seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than 1 Health. Taz'dingo!
zuljin.10_2: Zul'jin launches a massive axe into the air that drops on the targeted area, dealing 330~~0.04~~ damage plus bonus damage the lower his Health is.

zuljin.13_2: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant Zul'jin 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%.

zuljin.16_3:

Hero Takedowns instantly grant 40% Attack Speed.

zuljin.20_4: Basic Attacks bounce to a nearby enemy for 50% damage, prioritizing enemy Heroes.
